Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Address of agency: 497 Eastside, Docklands
Name of agent: Becky
Phone number: 07866 510333
Best to call her in the
Typical jobs
Clerical and admin roles, mainly in the finance industry
Must have good skills
Jobs are usually for at least one
Pay is usually £ per hour
Registration process
Wear a to the interview
Must bring your to the interview
They will ask questions about each applicant's
Advantages of using an agency
The you receive at interview will benefit you
Will get access to vacancies which are not advertised
Less is involved in applying for jobs

transcript.en: Hello, William! This is Amber. You said to phone if I wanted to get more information about the job agency you mentioned? Is now a good time?
transcript.zh: 你好,威廉!这是安布尔。你说如果我想了解更多关于你提到的职业介绍所的信息的话就可以打电话。现在有时间吗?

transcript.en: Hi, Amber. Yes, fine. The agency I was talking about is called Bankside. They're based in Docklands - I can tell you the address now - 497 Eastside.
transcript.zh: 嗨,安布尔。嗯嗯有空的。我说的这个机构叫做Bankside。他们在码头区。我现在就可以告诉你地址。497 Eastside。

transcript.en: Ok, thanks. So is there anyone in particular I should speak to there?
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。那有什么人是我特别要找的吗?

transcript.en: The agent I always deal with is called Becky Jamieson.
transcript.zh: 我一直打交道的经纪人叫贝基·杰米森。

transcript.en: Let me write that down. Becky......
transcript.zh: 让我写下来。贝基……

transcript.en: Jamieson. J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N.
transcript.zh: 杰米森。J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N。

transcript.en: Do you have her direct line?
transcript.zh: 你有她的直拨电话吗?

transcript.en: Yes, it's in my contact somewhere. Right. Here we are....07866510333 I wouldn't call her until the afternoon if I were you. She's always really busy in the morning, trying to fill last-minute vacancies. She's really helpful and friendly, so I'm sure it will be worth getting in touch with her for an informal chat.
transcript.zh: 威廉:是的，在我通讯录的某个地方。是的。在这里....07866510333.如果我是你，我到下午才会给她打电话。她早上总是很忙，试图在最后一分钟填补空缺。她很乐于助人，也很友好，所以我相信与她闲谈一次是值得的。

transcript.en: It's mainly clerical and admin jobs they deal with, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 主要是文书和行政工作，是吗?

transcript.en: That's right. I know you're hoping to find a full-time job in the media eventually. But Becky mostly recruits temporary staff for the finance sector, which will look good on your CV and generally pays better, too.
transcript.zh: 是的。我知道你想找一份媒体行业的全职工作。但贝基主要为金融部门招聘临时员工，这会给你的简历添彩，而且也能帮你提高薪水。

transcript.en: Yeah......I'm just a bit worried because I don't have much office experience.
transcript.zh: 是啊……我只是有点担心，因为我没有太多的办公经验。

transcript.en: I wouldn't worry. They'll probably start you as a receptionist or something like that. So what's important for that kind of job isn't so much having business skills or knowing lots of different computer systems. It's communication that really matters. So you'd be fine there. And you'll pick up office skills really quickly on the job. It's not that complicated.
transcript.zh: 我不担心。他们可能会先让你做接待员之类的工作。对于这类工作来说，重要的不是拥有商业技能或了解大量的计算机系统。真正重要的是沟通。所以你会没事的。你会在工作中很快学会办公室技能。这并不复杂。

transcript.en: Okay, good. So how long do people generally need temporary staff for? It would be great if I could get something lasting at least a month.
transcript.zh: 好,很好。那么，人们一般需要临时员工多长时间?如果我能得到至少雇佣一个月的工作就太好了。

transcript.en: That shouldn't be too difficult. But you're more likely to be offered something for a week at first, which might get extended. It's unusual to be sent somewhere for just a day or two.
transcript.zh: 那应该不会太难。但你更有可能在一开始就得到一个为期一周的工作机会，这个时间可能会延长。如果只是一两天，被安排到某个地方是不太现实的。

transcript.en: Right. I've heard the pay isn't too bad, better than working in a shop or a restaurant.
transcript.zh: 对。我听说工资不是很低，比在商店或餐馆工作要好。

transcript.en: Oh, yes. Definitely. The hourly rate is about 10 pounds, 11 if you are lucky.
transcript.zh: 噢,是的。肯定。每小时大约10英镑，如果你够幸运的话，11英镑。

transcript.en: That's pretty good. I was only expecting to get eight or nine pounds an hour.
transcript.zh: 那太好了。我本来只期望每小时能挣8到9英镑。

transcript.en: Do you want me to tell you anything about the registration process?
transcript.zh: 你想让我告诉你关于注册流程的事情吗?

transcript.en: Yes, please. I know you have to have an interview.
transcript.zh: 是的,可以吗。我知道你得去面试。

transcript.en: The interview usually takes about an hour and you should arrange that about a week in advance.
transcript.zh: 面试通常需要一个小时，你应该提前一周左右安排。

transcript.en: I suppose I should dress smartly if it's for office work. I can probably borrow a suit from Mum.
transcript.zh: 如果是办公室工作的话，我想我应该穿得正式一点。我或许可以向我妈借一套西装。

transcript.en: Good idea! It's better to look too smart than too casual.
transcript.zh: 好主意!穿得太正式总比太随便好。

transcript.en: Will I need to bring copies of my exam certificates or anything like that?
transcript.zh: 我需要带我的考试证书或类似的东西吗?

transcript.en: No. They don't need to see those, I don't think......
transcript.zh: 没有。他们不需要看到这些，我不认为……

transcript.en: What about my passport?
transcript.zh: 那我的护照呢?

transcript.en: Oh yes, they will ask to see that.
transcript.zh: 哦，是的，他们会要求看的。

transcript.en: Okay...
transcript.zh: 好吧…

transcript.en: I wouldn't get stressed about the interview though, it's just a chance for them to build relationship with you so they can try and match you to a job which you'll like. So there are questions about personality that they always ask candidates, fairly basic ones and they probably won't ask anything too difficult, like what your plans are for the future.
transcript.zh: 我不会因为面试而感到压力，这只是他们和你建立关系的一个机会，这样他们就可以尝试找到一份你喜欢的工作。所以他们总是会问应聘者一些关于性格的问题，基本的问题，他们可能不会问任何困难的问题，比如你未来的计划。

transcript.en: (Chuckle.....)Hope not.
Anyway there are lots of benefits to using an agency. For example, the interview will be useful because they'll give you feedback on your performance so you can improve next time.
transcript.zh: 不管怎样，使用中介机构有很多好处。例如，面试就会很有用，因为他们会给你的表现反馈，这样你下次就可以提高。

transcript.en: And I'll have access to jobs which aren't advertised.
transcript.zh: 而且我还能找到没有登广告的工作。

transcript.en: Exactly. Most temporary jobs aren't advertised.
transcript.zh: 没错。大多数临时工作都不登广告。

transcript.en: And I expect finding a temporary job this way takes a lot less time. It's much easier than ringing up individual companies.
transcript.zh: 我希望通过这种方式找到一份临时的工作可以节省很多时间。这比给个别公司打电话容易多了。

transcript.en: Yes, indeed. Well, I think I covered...
transcript.zh: 没错。我想我说过…
